items.name: Ginger Tofu Broccoli Stir-Fry
steps: Cut the cubed firm tofu and broccoli florets into small, even pieces and keep them close to the stove.
Heat the sesame oil in a wide pan and cook the ginger until aromatic.
Add the ingredients in order from firmest to softest, tossing after each addition.
Sprinkle in the water and rock salt with the sesame seeds; cover for three minutes.
Uncover and toss over lively heat until tender-crisp and glossy, then serve immediately.
items.guidance: Ginger Tofu Broccoli Stir-Fry is quickly cooked but served hot, with vegetables kept tender rather than raw. Vata: serve warm, cook until tender, and add a little ghee if the dish feels dry. Pitta: moderate chilies and sharp sourness, favoring coriander or fennel. Kapha: keep the portion light, reduce added fat, and favor ginger or black pepper.
provenance: original East or Southeast Asian stir-fry adaptation

items.name: Tofu Pumpkin Coconut Curry
steps: Blend the fresh coconut with half the water and strain or leave it fine-textured for a rustic coconut base.
Warm the coconut oil and bloom the ginger and coriander.
Add the cubed firm tofu and diced pumpkin with the turmeric and fresh basil; turn for two minutes.
Pour in the coconut mixture and remaining water, add rock salt, and simmer gently until everything is tender.
Keep the final boil brief so the coconut sauce stays smooth, then serve warm.
